name: NAPALM
description: Napalm (Whipsaw/3-5-7) is a multi-stage poker variant emphasizing bluffing. 4-7 players. 52-card deck. Three stages: Stage 1 (2 cards, best high), Stage 2 (+3 community, best LOW 5-card), Stage 3 (+2 more, best HIGH 5-card). Each stage: declare 'yes/no' if you think you have best hand. Single yes=token. Multiple yes=side bets. First to collect 5 tokens wins the pot.

content.text: Napalm (Whipsaw/3-5-7) is a multi-stage poker variant emphasizing bluffing. 4-7 players. 52-card deck. Three stages: Stage 1 (2 cards, best high), Stage 2 (+3 community, best LOW 5-card), Stage 3 (+2 more, best HIGH 5-card). Each stage: declare 'yes/no' if you think you have best hand. Single yes=token. Multiple yes=side bets. First to collect 5 tokens wins the pot.

This unusual poker variant was contributed by Michael Sanderson. Exact origin is unclear but it likely originated in the Northeastern USA; it was certainly played at Brandeis University (Massachusetts) and now has a following in the Maryland-Virginia area and Annapolis, where it is standard fare at several poker games. The name Napalm is of unknown origin.
52 cards. Aces high. Tokens (non-monetary) + chips for side bets.
